show_ui_on_interaction.title: Show Ui On Interaction
show_ui_on_interaction.description: Determines whether interacting with this block opens its container UI. Defaults to true. When false, normal block interaction events can run instead.

slot_count.title: Slot Count
slot_count.description: Sets the number of slots in the container.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional container title, stored as a language file key or raw text. Must be nonempty and at most 256 characters.
